integration_evidence: src/app/ApplicationContext.h declares the application composition root.
AGENTS.md defines app as the only composition root and UI-to-application plus rendering dependency direction.
src/ui/AGENTS.md requires MVVM/UDF screen state and public FluentQt APIs.

layer_ownership.app: Application bootstrap and dependency composition only.
layer_ownership.core: Foundational utilities with no feature-layer dependency.
layer_ownership.domain: Business concepts and invariants with no Widgets or FluentQt.
layer_ownership.application: Use cases, ports, workflow coordination, immutable renderable state, and operation policy.
layer_ownership.rendering: Deterministic Qt Core/Gui layout and rasterization shared by preview and export, without Widgets, I/O, ports, or application dependencies.
layer_ownership.infrastructure: Services, data, and network adapters implementing application ports, persistence, external I/O, and engines.
layer_ownership.ui: FluentQt presentation, canvas, models, delegates, navigation, and ViewModels that render state and emit intent.

dependency_direction: app -> all layers for construction only
compatibility_note: The generic full-profile infrastructure layer maps to MangaTranslator's existing services, data, and network roots. Existing UI uses ui/window, ui/screen, ui/manga, ui/navigation, ui/widget, and ui/base rather than the template's shell/pages/components aliases; no production files are moved by this Task 1 artifact gate.
